heard: After the mountain and the ramp, Abraham heard the news again. His brother Nahar had more sons born in the distant land. His concubine Rehoma bore four sons to the old clan. Tema was the firstborn son Written in the genealogy Gaham, Tahash, and Naka Followed in the list Names from the Mesopotamian shore Where the patriarchs dwelled His concubine Ryoma bore four sons to the old clan
